parameters.query:
SELECT
    ss.id AS session_id,
    ss.candidate_id,
    ss.job_id,
    c.full_name AS candidate_name,
    c.discipline::text AS candidate_discipline,
    c.years_experience::text,
    c.headline,
    c.strengths,
    c.concerns_or_gaps,
    c.best_fit_role_types,
    c.summary_self,
    c.cv_filename,
    j.role_title,
    j.discipline AS job_discipline,
    j.employee_instruction,
    j.pain_hypothesis,
    j.location_city,
    j.location_state,
    comp.name AS company_name,
    j.inferred_client_name,
    m.ai_match_reasoning,
    m.ai_match_concerns,
    m.ai_compatibility_score
FROM screening_sessions ss
JOIN candidates c ON c.id = ss.candidate_id
JOIN jobs j ON j.id = ss.job_id
LEFT JOIN companies comp ON comp.id = j.company_id
LEFT JOIN candidate_job_matches m ON m.id = ss.match_id
WHERE ss.id = '{{ $json.body.session_id }}'::uuid;

INSERT INTO screening_responses (
    session_id,
    question_number,
    question_text,
    expected_answer,
    poor_answer_indicators,
    difficulty
)
VALUES (
    '{{ $json.session_id }}'::uuid,
    {{ $json.question_number }},
    '{{ $json.question_text.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ $json.expected_answer.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ ($json.poor_answer_indicators ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ $json.difficulty }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (session_id, question_number) DO UPDATE SET
    question_text = EXCLUDED.question_text,
    expected_answer = EXCLUDED.expected_answer,
    poor_answer_indicators = EXCLUDED.poor_answer_indicators,
    difficulty = EXCLUDED.difficulty,
    updated_at = now()
RETURNING id, question_number;
